environment.description: Terraform provider state backend running on EC2 instance in a public subnet. The instance has an IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on the state bucket (arn:aws:s3:::acme-tf-state-prod/*). The S3 bucket has no bucket policy restrictions. Network access to port 8080 is allowed from the CI/CD CIDR range (10.0.0.0/8) and also from any VPC-peered network. The hardcoded AES key and static IV allow any party with network access to decrypt intercepted state files or craft valid encrypted payloads to overwrite state.

config.encryption: application-layer AES-128-CFB with hardcoded key and static IV
